prompt:
You are a meticulous equity research assistant. Compile valuation inputs for the publicly listed company with ticker "BUD" (the ticker may carry an exchange suffix such as .SI, .HK, .L, .T, .AS). Use the most recent figures you know. Never invent numbers: use null for anything you do not know.

Reply with ONLY one JSON object, no other text, in exactly this shape:
{
 "ticker": "BUD", "name": "company name", "exchange": "primary exchange",
 "currency": "reporting currency of the financial statements, ISO code",
 "priceCurrency": "trading currency of this listing, ISO code",
 "fxToPriceCurrency": number (1 unit of reporting currency in price currency; 1 if the same),
 "price": last known share price in priceCurrency, "priceDate": "YYYY-MM",
 "fiscalYearEnd": "month",
 "revenueHistory": [{"fy":"FY2020","revenue":number}, ...]  (the last 6 completed fiscal years, oldest first, in MILLIONS of reporting currency),
 "dilutedSharesHistory": [{"fy":"FY2020","shares":number}, ...]  (weighted diluted shares for the same 6 years, oldest first, in MILLIONS, split-adjusted to today's share basis),
 "sharesOutstanding": weighted-average DILUTED share count from the company's MOST RECENT QUARTERLY report (10-Q, or the latest interim/half-year report outside the US), in MILLIONS (express per listed security, i.e. ADR-equivalents for ADRs),
 "sharesAsOf": "quarter ended YYYY-MM-DD" for that share count,
 "cash": cash plus short-term investments in MILLIONS of reporting currency, latest balance sheet,
 "totalDebt": short plus long-term debt in MILLIONS of reporting currency, latest balance sheet,
 "balanceSheetDate": "YYYY-MM",
 "currentNetMargin": latest fiscal-year net margin as a decimal,
 "optimizedMargin": decimal net margin this business could sustain at maturity if run to maximize profit from its revenue (use industry peers at maturity),
 "marginRationale": "one short sentence",
 "maturity": one of "hyper-growth","high-growth","growth","mature","declining",
 "projections": [ {"source":"firm or consensus provider name","g1":decimal,"g3":decimal,"g5":decimal,"note":"short basis, e.g. FY2027 revenue estimate $X","url":null} ],
 "dataAsOf": "YYYY-MM of the newest data you used",
 "caveats": "one short sentence on anything uncertain, or null"
}
For "projections": list every analyst revenue growth projection you know for this company: the consensus, the high and low estimates, and each named broker or research firm. g1 is next-fiscal-year revenue growth; g3 and g5 are annualized revenue CAGRs over 3 and 5 years; all are measured from the last completed fiscal year in revenueHistory. Use null for horizons a source does not cover. Growth rates are decimals (0.15 = 15%).
Look hard for 3- and 5-year forecasts, not just next year's. Sources that publish revenue estimates for several fiscal years ahead include StockAnalysis (annual revenue estimates, usually 3-5 years), MarketScreener, Morningstar, Zacks, Simply Wall St, Seeking Alpha and named brokers' published models; the company's own medium- or long-term revenue targets (investor day or guidance) count too, with "source" naming them as company guidance. Where a source gives revenue estimates for individual future fiscal years, work out g3 and g5 as the CAGR from the last completed fiscal year's revenue to the FY+3 and FY+5 estimates, and put those estimates in "note". For each horizon, give the consensus and, where published, its low and high estimates as separate entries. Never fill a horizon by copying another horizon's rate.

result.name: Anheuser-Busch InBev SA/NV
result.exchange: Euronext Brussels (primary; ADSs on NYSE as BUD, one ADS per ordinary share; also Mexico and Johannesburg)
result.marginRationale: With a 35.8% normalized EBITDA margin but about $4.5B of yearly net finance costs, continued deleveraging could lift net margin toward the mid-to-high teens that mature brewer Constellation Brands earns (18.5% in FY2026).

projections.note: FY2026 revenue estimate $64.7B (26 analysts); later years behind paywall; updated Oct 13, 2026; much of 2026 growth is currency (HY26 reported +11.5% vs organic +5.7%)
Revenue forecasts $64,689M FY2026 (26 analysts), $67,283M FY2027 (26), $69,899M FY2028 (24); Oct 2026

result.caveats: Shares, cash and debt are from the unaudited H1 2026 interim report (diluted weighted average 2,009M for the six months); cash includes $353M of current investment securities and debt is interest-bearing loans (including leases) of $72,288M plus $29M bank overdrafts; net margin uses profit attributable to equity holders; Q3 2026 results are expected around Oct 29, 2026.
